messages:
Marisol (Partners): Heads-up — planning a Partner API compatibility change: response envelope v3 (flattened metadata + small auth header rename). Targeting ~6-week runway. Need coordination: cloud marketplace resubmission, hardware partner firmware checks, SI integration releases. Who can own announcements + migration helpers?

Amy H: Can you paste a concise diff of the payload so SDK teams can triage? Also need to know if this affects private/Dedicated control-plane only or hosted customers too.

Marisol (Partners): Short diff below — main change is `meta` moved into top-level fields and `X-Partner-Auth` -> `X-Partner-Auth-V2`. A few responses include an additional `service_hint` string. Affects all modes (hosted + dedicated + private).

```json
// old response
{ "meta": { "request_id": "...", "region": "..." }, "payload": {...} }

// new response
{ "request_id": "...", "region": "...", "service_hint": "edge", "payload": {...} }

// header change
X-Partner-Auth: token -> X-Partner-Auth-V2: token
```

Kevin L: For Dedicated/Private we must not break customers. Proposal: ship feature-flag gating so infra can opt-in per-tenant for 90 days. Add a runtime compat-layer that rewrites v3->v2 for older SDKs. I can own the runtime adapter.

Jon P: I'll prepare SDK releases with an auto-detect + fallback. Plan: release client 3.2.0 with: auto-detect header check, opt-in migration helper, and deprecation logs. ETA: SDK PR in 10 business days. Snippet I plan to include for partners: 

```python
# migrate to v3 with fallback
client = RedwoodClient()
if client.server_supports('envelope_v3'):
    resp = client.call(..., envelope='v3')
else:
    resp = client.call(..., envelope='v2')
    # shim: map top-level fields back into meta for older code paths
```

Priya R: Marketing/PR notes: partners require a 2-week review window on any joint messaging. Marketplace listings typically take 3 business days for reapproval; hardware partners will need a firmware/SDK compatibility note. We should avoid a public announcement before partners sign off — request an embargo. Who will collect the partner signoffs? :calendar: :eyes:

Marisol (Partners): I'll collect signoffs. Impacted partner groups: cloud marketplaces (Marketplace integrations), hardware partners (Ionix, EdgeWorks), and SIs (FastIntegrate, AccelSys). Will ping legal for the embargo.

MarketplaceBot: Next marketplace resubmission window: earliest slot 2026-07-20 — approval ETA 2-4 business days. Please include a compatibility note and migration guide in the submission.

Amy H: Ops concerns: add e2e migration tests + a canary plan. Recommend 1% traffic canary for one week, monitor error rate and latency. Auto-rollback if error rate > 2% or token failures spike.

Kevin L: We'll implement the runtime circuit-breaker so requests can fall back to v2 envelope automatically. Also will expose a per-tenant flag in the console for opt-in/out during the runway.

Jon P: Actionable SDK checklist I'm tracking: 1) add envelope auto-detect, 2) ship 3.2.0 with migration helper, 3) include clear migration README + code snippets, 4) instrument deprecation warnings to telemetry.

Priya R: Draft timeline suggestion: Week 0: partner outreach + legal embargo. Week 2: SDK + runtime adapters ready for internal canary. Week 3-4: 1% canary, partner verification. Week 6: gated public announcement + marketplace re-submit. Comments?

Marisol (Partners): That timeline works for me. I'll open a shared doc and a partner 2-week review window. Please add one-line owners to each line item: SDK (Jon), Runtime adapter (Kevin), E2E + canary (Amy), Partner outreach & signoffs (Marisol), PR draft + press embargo (Priya).

Amy H: I'll start writing the e2e tests and a small canary runbook. Leaving a TODO to add alerting thresholds to the runbook.

Kevin L: I'll create the runtime PR and a toggle in the console. Will add compatibility adapter docs for SREs.

Jon P: Will open SDK PRs and draft migration examples for Node/Python/Go. I'll also add an opt-in environment variable to force v3 for testing.

Priya R: I'll draft the partner-facing announcement and share the PR in this channel for review. Please try to get signoffs within the two-week window.

Marisol (Partners): Thanks — I'll create the shared doc and invite the partner managers. If anyone has objections to the runway/timeline, drop them here today. Otherwise I'll kick off partner outreach this afternoon. :thumbsup:
